item.title: Power Mech Projects Subsidiary Debuts in Energy Storage with 1 GWh WBSEDCL BESS Order
item.description: Power Mech Projects Limited (PMPL) subsidiary PM Green Private Limited has secured a contract for a 1 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) from the West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL). The company announced in a press release that it has been awarded a 250 MW / 1,000 MWh BESS contract under a Build, Own, Operate (BOO) model, with a 100% off-take guarantee from WBSEDCL. item.title: Envision Energy Enters Brazil Market via 630 MW Casa dos Ventos Wind Deal
item.description: Envision Energy has recently signed a 630MW wind turbine supply and a 30-year long-term service agreement with Casa dos Ventos, a Brazilian renewable energy developer. The company explained in a press release that this project marks Envision's first net-zero energy deployment in Brazil and establishes a broader partnership, delivering AI-enabled, end-to-end renewable energy solutions. item.title: SECI Issues BoS Tender For 700 MW Solar Project In Gujarat
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued a tender for a 700 MW (AC) ground-mounted solar project in Gujarat. The tender is for the balance of system scope of the project. The project is located at Radha Nesda in Banaskantha district of the state. The scope of work involves comprehensive engineering and construction. item.title: GM to Take $6 Billion Hit as It Scales Back Electric Vehicle Investments
item.description: General Motors (GM) announced on Thursday that it would take a USD 6 billion charge to unwind portions of its electric-vehicle (EV) investments, becoming the latest automaker to scale back in response to the Trump administration’s policies and softening demand for battery-powered vehicles. GM’s EV sales fell 43 percent in the fourth quarter, following the loss of the federal tax credit. item.title: Luno Solar Bags Solar Module Orders For DRDO, Bangalore Solar Project
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer Luno Solar has secured an order to supply solar modules for a solar project being developed at a Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) facility in Bengaluru. The module supply contract has been awarded by NTPC Limited, which is implementing the solar project for the research organisation. item.title: ENGIE, NLC India, Rays Power & Oriana Bag SECI 1200 MW Solar With 6-Hr BESS Tender
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has announced the winners of its 1,200 MW solar power tender coupled with 600 MW / 3,600 MWh of battery energy storage system (BESS) with a six-hour storage duration. The successful bidders include ENGIE, NLC India, RPIL Power Three Pvt Ltd, and Oriana Power.
